about: A section line bound to an act whose record has since been renamed. The record answers queries and the line is the authoring handle (§1.3.1), so this is info: between commits the two may differ, and a line that has drifted is how an editor renames the wrong act.

findings.message: The section line reads "The Arrival" and the act it names is "The Thaw". The record answers queries (§1.3.1).
findings.title: Section line disagrees with the span it names
